description: Drain Soul 55 Mana 30 yd range Channeled (15 sec cast) Requires Warlock Requires level 10 Drains the soul of the target, causing 85 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.
name: Drain Soul
